---
title: "K-Factor Calculator"
subtitle: "AAVSO solar observers"
date: today
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
params:
  start_date: "2024-01-01"
  end_date: "2024-06-30"
  min_obs: 100
  zero_handling: "substitute"   # "substitute" (as in the Perl script) or "skip"
  output_file: "new_k-factors.txt"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
source("R/k_factor.R")

start_jd <- date_to_jd(params$start_date)
end_jd <- date_to_jd(params$end_date)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
con <- connect_solar_db()

last_jd <- last_ra_jd(con)
if (end_jd > last_jd) {
  stop("End date must be no later than ", jd_to_date(last_jd),
       " (the last date with an Ra value).", call. = FALSE)
}
if (end_jd - start_jd < 100) {
  stop("End date must be at least 100 days after the start date.", call. = FALSE)
}

observations <- fetch_observations(con, start_jd, end_jd)
ra <- fetch_ra(con, start_jd, end_jd)
old_k <- fetch_old_k(con)
dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
k_factors <- compute_k_factors(observations, ra,
                               min_obs = params$min_obs,
                               zero_handling = params$zero_handling) |>
  left_join(old_k, by = "obs") |>
  mutate(change = k - old_k)

write_k_factors(k_factors, params$output_file)
```

## Summary

Period **`r params$start_date`** to **`r params$end_date`**
(JD `r start_jd` to `r end_jd`).
**`r nrow(k_factors)`** observers had at least `r params$min_obs` observations.
Zero or missing values were handled with the **`r params$zero_handling`** method.
Results were written to `` `r params$output_file` ``.

Each k-factor is the geometric mean of Ra / W over the observer's
observations:

$$
k = 10^{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N} \left(\log_{10} Ra_i - \log_{10} W_i\right)}
$$

## K-factors

```{r}
#| label: tbl-k-factors
k_factors |>
  select(Observer = obs, Reported = n_reported, Used = n_used,
         `Zero/missing` = n_zero_or_missing,
         `New k` = k, `Old k` = old_k, Change = change) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

## New vs. old k-factors

```{r}
#| label: fig-new-vs-old
#| fig-cap: "Points above the dashed line got a larger k-factor than before."
k_factors |>
  filter(!is.na(old_k)) |>
  ggplot(aes(old_k, k)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(colour = "#12355b", size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = obs), vjust = -0.8, size = 3) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Old k-factor", y = "New k-factor") +
  theme_minimal()
```
